name: Steam Thruster One (2U unit)
notes: Water-propelled electrothermal thruster, 2U unit: thrust 5-20 mN (more at higher power), Isp 172 s, total impulse 1200 N s (the table gives 1000 N s per 1U water tank for custom tanks), minimum impulse bit 10 mN s, power 19.9 W thrusting (estimate marked in the sheet) and 0.12 W idle, 17-33 V, RS 422 or TTL UART, 208 x 102 x 121 mm, wet mass 1700 g with 700 g of water. 6+ systems flown, space qualified to ECSS-E-ST-10-03C and GSFC-STD-7000A.

name: Steam TunaCan Thruster
notes: Water electrothermal thruster built to fit the tunacan volume of CubeSat deployers (outside the main structure), total impulse 219 N s, operated at 5-20 W depending on the available power (power_w_firing = 20 W); on a 3U (5 kg) satellite at 400 km it gives 4.3 years life and +-70 km orbit change, on a 6U (10 kg) 3 years and +-35 km. Mass and size are not given.

name: TunaTank Thruster
notes: Water electrothermal thruster in the tunacan volume of CubeSat deployers with a larger tank: total impulse 600 N s, delta-v 114 m/s on a 3U (5 kg) and 58 m/s on a 6U (10 kg) satellite, orbit change +-206 km / +-105 km at 400 km. Mass, size and power are not given.
